info.title: HubSpot Commerce API
info.description: HubSpot Commerce API — merged from the vendor's per-API OpenAPI documents.

post.description: Create a new change for a commerce contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to submit a request to modify existing contracts by specifying the desired changes in the request body. Upon successful creation, the URL of the newly created resource is returned in the response.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Preview the changes to a commerce contract before they are applied. This endpoint allows you to simulate contract modifications, providing a preview of the resulting changes without committing them. It is useful for assessing the impact of proposed changes on a contract.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific contract change using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access information about the change, including its status, type, and any associated line item changes. It is useful for tracking the progress and details of contract modifications.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to retrieve.

patch.description: Update an existing contract change in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify details of a specific change identified by its changeId. Use this to adjust contract changes as needed before they are finalized.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to update.

post.description: Accept a specific contract change in the HubSpot commerce system. This endpoint is used to finalize and apply changes to a contract that have been proposed. It requires the unique identifier of the change to be accepted.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to accept.

post.description: Cancel a specific contract change in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you need to revoke a proposed or pending change to a contract. Once canceled, the change will no longer be processed.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to cancel.

post.description: Create a new contract in your HubSpot account using the Commerce Contracts API. This endpoint allows you to specify various contract details, including billing information, line items, and payment methods. The contract's effective date and currency code are required, along with other essential details. This operation returns the URL of the newly created contract resource upon successful creation.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve the details of a specific contract using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access comprehensive information about a contract, including its status, associated line items, and other relevant details. It is useful for reviewing contract specifics or integrating contract data into other systems.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to retrieve.

patch.description: Update an existing contract in your HubSpot account using the specified contract ID. This operation allows you to modify details of a contract, such as its properties and associated line items. Ensure that the contract ID is valid and corresponds to an existing contract.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to update.

get.description: Retrieve the changes associated with a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view all modifications made to a contract, which can be useful for tracking contract history and understanding the evolution of contract terms.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which changes are being retrieved.

post.description: Create a change for a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to propose modifications to the contract, such as adding, updating, or removing line items. The request body must include the necessary details for the contract change, and upon successful creation, a URL to the newly created resource will be returned.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the change is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Create a new renewal quote for a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to generate a renewal quote by specifying the contract ID and necessary details within the request body. The operation is useful for managing contract renewals and ensuring continuity in service agreements.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the renewal quote is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Terminate a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying the contract ID and can be used to end a contract as of a specified termination date. Ensure that the contract ID is valid and that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to terminate.

get.description: Retrieve a list of payment links from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter and sort payment links based on various criteria such as creation and update timestamps. It supports pagination and can include archived payment links if specified.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Filter results to include only those created after the specified timestamp.

parameters.name: createdAt
parameters.description: Filter results by the exact creation timestamp.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Filter results to include only those created before the specified timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Specifies the order in which results are returned.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Filter results to include only those updated after the specified timestamp.

parameters.name: updatedAt
parameters.description: Filter results by the exact update timestamp.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Filter results to include only those updated before the specified timestamp.

post.description: Create a new payment link in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify various attributes for the payment link, such as accepted payment methods, currency, and additional form fields. The payment link can be configured for one-time use and can also collect shipping and billing addresses. This operation requires a valid JSON request body. Some defaults will be applied if no value provided.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific payment link using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to access information about the payment link, including its status and configuration. It is useful for checking the current settings or status of a payment link in your HubSpot account.

parameters.name: paymentLinkId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the payment link to retrieve.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

delete.description: Delete a specific payment link in your HubSpot account. This operation is irreversible and will remove the payment link identified by the provided ID. Use this endpoint to manage and clean up payment links that are no longer needed.

parameters.name: paymentLinkId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the payment link to delete.

patch.description: Update a payment link by ID.

parameters.name: paymentLinkId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the payment link to update.

get.description: Retrieve the settings for payment methods in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about the current configuration of payment methods, including their capability status and supported currencies. It is useful for understanding which payment methods are active and their default status.

patch.description: Update the payment method settings for commerce transactions. This operation allows you to modify the configuration of payment methods, including setting defaults and managing supported currencies. Use this endpoint to ensure your payment methods align with your business requirements.

get.description: Retrieve the current billing settings for your HubSpot account's payment settings. This endpoint allows you to access billing configurations, which can be useful for managing and reviewing your account's payment setup.

patch.description: Update the billing settings for your HubSpot account's payment settings. This endpoint allows you to modify the billing configurations, which can be essential for managing how payments are processed and billed. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to write payment checkout settings before making changes.

get.description: Retrieve the current checkout fee settings for your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about any fees applied during the checkout process, which can be useful for understanding transaction costs and configuring payment settings.

patch.description: Update the checkout fees settings in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the configuration of checkout fees, which can be useful for adjusting fee structures or implementing new pricing strategies. Ensure that the request body contains the necessary details for the update.

delete.description: Remove a specific checkout fee from the payments settings in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful for managing and updating the fees associated with checkout processes. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

parameters.name: checkoutFeeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the checkout fee to delete.

get.description: Retrieve the current payment policy settings for your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides access to the policy configurations related to payment settings, allowing you to review the existing setup. It is useful for ensuring compliance with organizational or regulatory requirements by reviewing the policy settings in place.

patch.description: Update the payment policy settings for your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify existing policy configurations, which can include terms and conditions related to payments. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to write payment checkout settings before making changes.

get.description: Retrieve the current shipping settings for your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about the configured shipping options, which can be useful for managing and reviewing your shipping policies and configurations.

patch.description: Update the shipping settings for your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify existing shipping configurations to better suit your business needs. Ensure that the request body contains the necessary fields as defined in the UpdateShippingSettingsPublicRequest schema.

post.description: Create a manual payment in the HubSpot system. This endpoint allows you to specify details such as the payment amount, currency, payment method, and date. It is useful for recording payments that occur outside of automated systems, ensuring all payment data is captured within HubSpot.

Initiate an asynchronous retry of a payment associated with the specified CRM object ID. This endpoint is useful for attempting to process payments that may have previously failed or require reprocessing. Upon successful initiation, a task locator is returned to track the status of the retry operation.

parameters.name: paymentCrmObjectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the payment CRM object to retry.

get.description: Retrieve the status of a specific asynchronous retry task for a payment CRM object. This endpoint allows you to check the progress or completion status of a task that was initiated to retry a payment action.

parameters.name: paymentCrmObjectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the payment CRM object associated with the task.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the task whose status is being retrieved.

get.summary: Retrieve status and general information about a portal's payments account.
get.description: Retrieve the status of payment accounts in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about the account's ability to transact and payout, its enrollment state, when or if it has transacted last, and the types of payment processors it is eligible for. Use this to monitor and manage your payment account's operational status.

Retrieve a list of price books available in your HubSpot account. This endpoint supports pagination and can return archived price books if specified. It is useful for accessing and managing pricing information across different products and services.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

post.description: Create a new price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define custom properties, a name, and supported currencies for the price book. A successful request will return the URL of the newly created resource.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve a specific price book by its unique identifier in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a price book, including its status and supported currencies. It can be useful for managing and reviewing pricing strategies within your commerce system.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to retrieve.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

delete.description: Delete a specific price book from your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation will permanently remove the price book and its associated data, making it unavailable for future use.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to delete.

patch.description: Update an existing price book in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify details such as the name, description, supported currencies, and custom properties of a price book. It is useful for keeping your price book information up to date with the latest changes.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to update.

post.description: Activate a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This operation changes the status of the price book to active, allowing it to be used in transactions and other operations. Ensure that the price book ID is correct before activation.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to activate.

post.description: Deactivate a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This action changes the status of the price book to inactive, making it unavailable for use in transactions. Use this endpoint when you need to temporarily or permanently disable a price book without deleting it.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to deactivate.

get.description: Retrieve a list of items associated with a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through the items and specify which properties to include in the response. It is useful for managing and viewing the details of products linked to a particular price book.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to retrieve items for.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A list of property names to include in the response.

post.description: Add new items to a specified price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to associate products with a price book by providing the necessary product details. It is useful for managing and updating the contents of your price books efficiently.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to which items will be added.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive multiple items within a specified price book in a single batch operation. This endpoint is useful for managing large sets of price book items that need to be archived simultaneously, streamlining the process and reducing the number of individual requests.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book containing the items to be archived.

post.description: Create multiple items in a specified price book in a single batch operation. This endpoint is useful for efficiently adding a large number of items to a price book, reducing the need for multiple individual requests. The operation returns a batch response indicating the success or failure of each item creation.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to which the items will be added.

post.description: Update multiple items in a specified price book in a single batch operation. This endpoint allows for efficient updates of price book items, making it useful for managing large sets of data within a price book. The operation returns a batch response indicating the success or failure of each item update.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book containing the items to update.

get.description: Retrieve a specific item from a price book using its unique identifiers. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a particular item within a specified price book, including its properties and archived status if applicable.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book containing the item.

parameters.name: priceBookItemId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the item within the price book.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A list of property names to include in the response.

delete.description: Remove a specific item from a price book in your HubSpot account. This operation is irreversible and will permanently delete the item identified by the given priceBookItemId from the price book specified by priceBookId.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book from which the item will be deleted.

parameters.name: priceBookItemId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the item to be deleted from the price book.

patch.description: Update a specific item within a price book in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify details such as pricing, billing frequency, and custom properties for the specified item. Ensure that the item is identified correctly by its unique priceBookId and priceBookItemId.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book containing the item to update.

parameters.name: priceBookItemId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the item within the price book to update.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Validate a specific price book in your HubSpot account. This endpoint checks the integrity and correctness of the price book identified by the given priceBookId. Use this to ensure that the price book meets all necessary criteria before proceeding with further operations.

parameters.name: priceBookId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the price book to validate.
